title: Ribbon Cutting: Arvest Bank
seo_title: Arvest Bank Ribbon Cutting in Republic, MO on Dec 3
description: A ribbon cutting for Arvest Bank takes place on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 11:30 AM to 12:30 PM. It is held at U.S. Highway 60 and South Farm Road 103, near the Stone Creek Falls development, in Republic, Missouri. The Republic Area Chamber of Commerce is the organizer.
address: U.S. Highway 60 and South Farm Road 103 (near the Stone Creek Falls development)
